//: PLAN-008 AC-1 — the ownership contract, per template.
This is the single source of truth for who owns what in a scaffolded repo. cli.js embeds a
SNAPSHOT of the matching entry into each project's .rigel/manifest.json, so a repo keeps the
contract it was born with until an update explicitly changes it.
managed — Rigel owns these byte-for-byte. `rigel verify` fails if they are hand-edited;
`rigel update` overwrites them when untouched. Deliberately narrow: only the
harness itself. Anything a user reasonably tunes belongs in `seed`.
seed    — written once at scaffold, then the team owns it. Never overwritten, never diffed.
user    — Rigel must never read or write these.
Glob syntax is minimal on purpose (lib/manifest.mjs): `**` crosses separators, `*` does not,
everything else is literal. No negation, no braces — if a rule needs those, it's too clever.
